summary: This Form 6-K filed by NOVONIX Ltd announces the opening of a Share Purchase Plan (SPP) for eligible shareholders, allowing subscriptions of up to A$30,000 in new ordinary shares at the price of institutional placements, free of brokerage. The SPP opens June 22, 2026, and is expected to close August 14, 2026, subject to ASX waivers; if waivers are not granted, it becomes conditional on shareholder approval at a general meeting. The filing is a routine capital raising mechanism, not a special situation like a tender offer or going-private transaction.
